source.table: Table 5. Outlays of the U.S. Government, September 2026 and Other Periods
source.title: Outlays of the U.S. Government — Department of the Treasury, bureaus excluding IRS

unit_note: USD millions. '......' (No Transactions) and '(**)' (less than $500,000 in absolute value) cells are omitted, not transcribed as 0. Interest Paid to Credit Financing Accounts prints 10,492 this month and is inside the Fiscal Service total (new versus August). All-omission Transportation Services is dropped. 60 standalones, two above the August waiver of 58, on lines that roll up only in the departmental unit. Page 17. Audit #540 removed 4 repeated gross/net identities counted twice with their operands reversed. Page 17 prints the interest line (r13) between Financial Agent Services and Claims, Judgements, and Relief Acts. Its six numeric cells enter the Fiscal Service subtotal. The 60 standalone cells appear in the departmental unit as components of Treasury totals.
